scientific_integrity: Analytical proof for every exponent; e=1..4 exhaustive finite tests are supporting checks, not infinite proof. Earliest cited public context is 2011-11-13 arXiv v1 for the fixed classical cat map; the original identified ternary open problem is Chen et al. 2014.
scientific_limitations: Global map periods only; not orbit-length distribution for individual states or arbitrary SL(2) matrices. Earlier period-formula articles not fully accessible; complete historical priority not independently established.
title: Complete period census of generalized Arnold cat maps modulo powers of three
